setting.note: A narrator looks back over a lifetime in Belle Époque France, from a childhood village and a seaside resort to the aristocratic salons of Paris, chasing the way memory recovers lost time.

rights.originalWork: Public domain. Marcel Proust; the sequence appeared from 1913 to 1927 and the author died in 1922. Mapped here as a cited work: we store none of its text and reproduce no passages. The places are facts and the notes are our own.
rights.textSource: None stored. A cited book reproduces no text.

palette.note: The mauve of Proust's hawthorns and remembered afternoons, colour steeped in memory. A soft violet that clears WCAG AA on paper.
